en.description:
A small forest companion. A lantern trail. A little world to return to.

PocketQuest is a calm adventure played on Apple Watch. Meet Nib, follow The Lantern Trail, and make a short story choice at each illustrated stop. Keep your first memories, welcome new residents, and arrange the treasures you find in a home of your own.

A COMPLETE AUTHORED ADVENTURE
Explore six regions and 48 encounters, each with two written choices and an illustrated outcome. Discover six residents, twelve decorations, six postcards, and three forms for Nib. Revisit completed stories freely and try the other choice while keeping your original memory.

EVERYDAY STEPS, OPTIONAL
Trail Sparks open new visits. With your permission, eligible steps from the owning Watch become Sparks when PocketQuest updates available movement history. Phone steps are never added. Your Watch shows when movement was last refreshed.

CAMP WELCOMES QUIET DAYS
Three untimed Camp activities each offer one 10-Spark gift per campaign day. Camp works without movement permission, and activities remain replayable afterward. Camp-only progress takes longer, but it can complete the full unlocked trail. Nib never loses Bond because you rest or miss a day.

BEGIN FOR FREE
The first two tutorial visits cost no Sparks. The first region is free to play. One permanent in-app purchase unlocks regions 2–6. Later first visits cost 40 earned Sparks; Sparks are never sold. There are no subscriptions, ads, loot boxes, or paid random rewards.

YOUR WATCH PLAYS. YOUR PHONE REMEMBERS.
Apple Watch is required for gameplay. The iPhone companion shows a dated copy of your adventure: browse the atlas, collection and journal, share earned artwork, and export or review a backup. Choices, spending, decorating and backup replacement are confirmed on the Watch. Adventures do not merge.

The campaign and artwork are bundled for offline play. Purchase verification, restoring purchases, and transferring a copy between devices may need a connection. No custom account, developer-hosted save service, location tracking or HealthKit access is used.

Requires watchOS 10 or later for gameplay. The companion requires iOS 17 or later.
en.subtitle: A quiet world on your wrist
